reviews.text: First visit with our adopted Mastiff, who's a year and a half old. We were seen by Dr. Isabel, who was incredibly kind and professional, and all the staff were super friendly! Everything was very clean, the atmosphere was calm and relaxed, and our little dog (who's a bit of a whirlwind) was happy and calm because of it.
They have excellent service. The guy who bathes Cody, in particular, is very kind, treats him wonderfully, and makes him look gorgeous! We are very satisfied and highly recommend them.
We noticed our cat had injured herself and they gave us an appointment right away. They know how to handle cats, something all cat owners know isn't always the case!

We no longer live next door, but we still take our dog there because we trust the center and its professionals. Whether it's for bathing and grooming (which is done by someone with great care and skill, plus they have a glass partition so you can see them working), or for health issues, given their team and the different specialties they offer. Professionalism, naturalness, sincerity, affection for our furry friends, and humanity—we're delighted, and above all, a special mention for Silvia! She's a sweetheart, thank you so much! It's so nice to find trustworthy places. (Just a quick note that the price is high, and you always get a bit of a shock... but that's the reality when it comes to our pets' health. It's the same in any clinic. Sometimes it might be worthwhile to get health insurance, depending on the case, like with older pets). We will continue to trust their professionals! :)

The best!!! My girlfriend always takes our puppy Lola there and always comes back happy because they treat her wonderfully and do a fantastic job!!!!

100/100 recommended 😊

I was at the vet with my kitten and apart from the professionals, the little girl who attended to me, Isabel, was super friendly and very approachable. It's truly a pleasure when you're treated so well. Thank you so much!

I took my dog ​​in for a check-up that ended up requiring surgery, and since then, this has become my go-to veterinary clinic. Thank you so much for the excellent service!

PS: The grooming salon is top-notch too!
Very happy with the care and the veterinarians. My kitten will thank you.
What I liked most was the service and professionalism. It's very difficult to find such good professionals, and especially such dedicated ones.
Thank you so much, Santiago!
They treat you great, very professional, 100% recommended.

The establishment is spectacular: spacious, spotless, and meticulously maintained. But without a doubt, the best thing about it is the staff; all the employees are highly professional and offer exceptional, personalized service. You can tell when a place is truly successful thanks to the people behind it. Highly recommended.
Very kind and treated my cat very well, efficient with my cat's paperwork, very clean place, helpful service and well-prepared team
Thank you so much, Gon :)
As a new resident to Spain I needed registration paperwork and new vaccinations. They were very patient with my old dog and with me.

I came with my cat worried about her condition, and the team's equal measure of humane and professional treatment made a difficult situation much more bearable and understandable. They resolved everything with great professionalism, and we're finally back home.
TOTAL QUALITY!
Wonderful clinic, they cured my dog ​​using all the necessary tools for a complete and painless recovery.

A fantastic experience at this veterinary hospital. They treated my dog ​​with professionalism and so much care. They were incredibly accommodating. I'm so glad I switched vets. They've gained a customer for life!
Thank you so much Perla for that feedback, we're here for anything you need :)
My dog ​​and I have always been treated with great care, and I go to this clinic whenever I can. Thank you all.

The phone service is terrible! I called twice to ask if they have dog insurance, and just saying no was enough, but the person who answered hung up repeatedly! Last week I spoke to someone else, and the person I spoke to today was nice. I hope they transfer her!
The management and organization used to be much better.... I'm sorry, I won't be back.
I won't be back... The only good things were the previous hairdressers and vets, and now even those are gone...
Professional, competent, ethical, and humane staff. Good facilities.

I was sold a large bag of dog food full of ants. After filing a complaint with a photo of the leaky bag and acknowledging the supplier's mistake, I still have the ant-infested bag at home. Today, after more than a month of complaining and reminding them that I'm still waiting for an exchange, they tell me they won't exchange or refund it.
It's a disgrace. I certainly won't be going back, and I don't recommend them to anyone.

I am incredibly grateful to all the veterinary and veterinary technicians for their professionalism and care of the patients. My 14-year-old cat, Leo, and I couldn't be happier with this wonderful veterinary hospital and clinic right in the heart of Madrid. I have complete trust in you and am immensely grateful for your hard work and kindness.
Both times I've been there, they've been incredibly friendly and treated the cats wonderfully. We'll definitely be back.
Very nice and polite staff. Came here with the dog about 5 times, everything was always great.

At this veterinary clinic, I encountered very kind people, which is always appreciated. However, I believe that kindness alone isn't enough when it comes to our pets' health. I took my 4-month-old puppy there, and without explaining the potential risks, they administered a vaccine while bathing him. It seemed strange to me at the time, as he was very nervous, and later, after consulting with other professionals, I learned that this can be dangerous for his immune system and increase the risk of adverse reactions. I also understood how stressful it must have been for him to have both experiences combined. For this reason, I decided not to return. I believe it's essential that, in addition to kind treatment, there is professionalism and responsible care to avoid putting our little ones at risk.
